functions.name: ACL2::FN-DI-RAW-GUARDED-PROBLEM
body: ~x0 is not declared and verified for raw-guarded execution
~x0 raw-guarded arity disagrees with its world
~x0 raw-guarded input slots disagree with its world
~x0 raw-guarded output slots disagree with its world
~x0 raw-guarded guard contains a kind, invariant, or relation beyond supplied stobj recognition

functions.name: ACL2::FN-DI-RAW-GUARDED-TARGET
body: ~x0 lacks its registered stobj creator role
~x0 has missing or incompatible registered creator EXEC metadata

functions.name: ACL2::FN-DI-RAW-WITH-PROBLEM
body:
:raw-with on ~x0, which is not :common-lisp-compliant: only a ~
                guard-verified definition executes faithfully raw

:raw-with on ~x0, whose guard conjunct ~x1 constrains the ~
                host-passed argument ~x2: no preservation theorem establishes ~
                a per-call argument, and raw dispatch would leave it unchecked

:raw-with on ~x0, whose guard has no conjunct beyond its kind ~
                checks and boot-strap primitives: raw dispatch would skip ~
                nothing
:raw-with names ~x0, which is not a theorem in this world

:raw-with on ~x0: no named theorem concludes ~x1, a guard ~
                conjunct raw dispatch leaves unevaluated (the named theorems ~
                are ~&2)

:raw-with on ~x0: no named positive preservation theorem for ~x1 ~
                mentions this entry under no hypotheses stronger than its guard

:raw-with names ~x0, which mentions no function of ~x1's ~
                guard argument (~&2)
